limitations: GitHub Pages is not deployed; OAuth Client ID remains blank. Public sources need no account. Private maps, acknowledgements and vendor integrations remain outside this prototype.
Live playback was verified at Avenue 9; other HLS endpoints were probed, not all played. Publisher availability, codecs, buffering and latency vary.
Video is on demand and stops when panel/tab is hidden. There is no media archive, background guarantee or automated camera-content monitoring.
3D was checked in the in-app Chromium browser; physical phones, EOC displays and alternative browser/GPU combinations still need county acceptance.
The browser logged a terrain texture-compression warning while rendering the checked scene successfully. Hardware-dependent 3D performance is not certified; 2D remains available.
Camera views do not establish river visibility, water depth, bridge clearance or a safe staging location. Terrain, basemap imagery and FEMA are planning references, not current inundation.
FEMA and camera services can fail independently of NWPS. Missing thresholds stay unknown; no county action thresholds, asset exposure, routing or staging recommendations have been implemented.
Full keyboard/screen-reader testing and operator validation remain necessary. Mobile check used a simulated viewport, not physical hardware.
Foreground refresh intervals are application checks, not publisher freshness or delivery guarantees. See prior validation for unchanged source-model limitations.
DuckDB/cloud-native file querying and role-specific EOC workflows remain future increments.
